name: Claude Code
notes: Plugins and MCP servers installed at user scope are also picked up by Claude Cowork local sessions, which read the same user settings. The GUI process gets a minimal PATH on both platforms, so every install channel is probed directly: the native installer's ~/.local/bin (claude on macOS/Linux, claude.exe on Windows), Homebrew's bin dirs, npm shims (npm.cmd dir, nvm/volta/pnpm/asdf), and the copy bundled inside Claude Desktop. The newest version among the candidates wins.
